# Feature Request

## Description

Describe the feature you would like to add.

## Problem

Explain the problem this feature would solve.

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you think this feature should work.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or approaches you considered.

## Additional Context

Add screenshots, examples, references, or any other relevant information.

## Checklist

- [ ] I checked if this feature was already requested.
- [ ] This feature aligns with the project's goals.
- [ ] I provided enough details to evaluate the request.
